verdict.rationale: Smooth documents its own proxy support. You can pass proxy server details in task parameters to run tasks from a different IP (smooth-docs-4, smooth-docs-18), and a community comment quotes its marketing as advertising "proxy rotation" (smooth-comm-3). There is no evidence of stealth or fingerprint-masking features, and nothing shows residential or geo-targeted proxy options; the documented feature looks like bring-your-own proxy. Missing for 10: stealth/fingerprint randomization, built-in residential proxy pool, geo-targeting controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of anti-bot effectiveness.
